claim.value: Missingness can create apparent temporal patterns.
claim.scope: A possible distortion of the observed booking sequence; limited to creating apparent patterns, excluding concealment.

provenance.rationale: The mapping explicitly lists missingness among factors that can create apparent patterns.

signal_basis.value: Repeated booking observations show temporal patterns in stage delays, late-start rates or delay duration, with recording completeness and missing-record counts tracked alongside them.
signal_basis.scope: Daily review and weekly summaries of the turnaround sequence; the described patterns are assumed observed for this judgment.

provenance.rationale: These spans specify the repeated summaries, candidate temporal patterns and accompanying completeness information, while identifying the signals as prospective.
The bounded possibility claim does not require an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Missing records can change which bookings contribute to successive summaries. If omissions differ over time or by delay status, the recorded sequence can exhibit a pattern without a corresponding change in the underlying process. This licenses the stated possibility even when recording and review procedures are followed.
uncertainty: The signal does not establish that missingness actually produced any particular observed pattern; the claim asserts only that it can.
